qrcode-generator, QR code encoder (used by /qr-code-generator/ and /wifi-qr-code-generator/)
=========================================================================================

qrcode.min.js
  Package:  qrcode-generator 2.0.4 (MIT), by Kazuhiko Arase
  Source:   https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz
            https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
  File:     dist/qrcode.js from the package, minified with terser. The code is
            unchanged apart from minification. It defines the global function
            qrcode(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel); pages switch its byte
            mode to UTF-8 with qrcode.stringToBytesFuncs['UTF-8'].
